title: Stop Guessing, Start Building: Introducing UpVote, the Feedback Widget That Actually Drives Product Decisions
description: Every product manager knows the struggle. You're staring at a roadmap full of 'nice-to-haves,' but you're not 100% sure which feature will actually move the needle.

metadata.title: Introducing Monkfeed: The Embeddable Feedback Widget for SaaS
metadata.description: Stop guessing what features to build. Meet Monkfeed, a lightweight, embeddable customer feedback widget that helps SaaS teams prioritize roadmaps and capture real-time insights.
metadata.keywords: feedback widget, customer feedback tool, SaaS product management, feature prioritization, product roadmap, embeddable feedback widget, user feedback software, Monkfeed launch, SaaS growth

sections.heading: Why Most Feedback Fails (And How UpVote Fixes It)
sections.content:
Traditional feedback loops are broken. Feature requests pile up in scattered spreadsheets, support tickets, Slack threads, and email inboxes. Product teams end up guessing what to build next based on whoever shouted loudest — usually the last person in the room, not the customer with the most at stake.

The result? Roadmaps that drift away from what users actually need, wasted engineering cycles, and customers who feel unheard because their feedback disappeared into a black hole.

UpVote fixes this by giving you a single, embeddable feedback widget and voting board that lives right inside your product. Instead of feedback scattered across a dozen tools, everything flows into one place where your team can see it, prioritize it, and act on it.

sections.heading: The UpVote Difference: Real-Time, Contextual Feedback
sections.content:
Most feedback tools ask users to leave your product and go fill out a form somewhere else. By the time they get there, the friction has already killed half your responses.

UpVote embeds directly into your app, website, or dashboard, so users can submit feedback in the exact moment they're experiencing something — a bug, a missing feature, a moment of delight. That context matters. Feedback captured in the flow of real usage is more specific, more actionable, and far more likely to actually get submitted in the first place.

No redirects. No separate login. No context switching. Just a lightweight widget that feels like a native part of your product.

sections.heading: Smart Prioritization, Not Just Noise
sections.content:
Collecting feedback is easy. Knowing what to do with it is the hard part.

UpVote turns raw feedback into a prioritized signal by letting users vote on the ideas that matter most to them. Instead of relying on gut feeling or the most recent complaint, your team can see — at a glance — which requests have the most demand behind them.

This shifts the conversation from "what do we think users want" to "what do users actually want," backed by real votes from real customers.

sections.heading: Rich Discussions, Not Just Data Points
sections.content:
A vote count tells you *what* people want. It doesn't tell you *why*. UpVote adds threaded comments and discussions to every feedback item, so users can explain their use case, add context, and build on each other's ideas.

This turns your feedback board into a genuine dialogue between your team and your customers — not just a leaderboard of upvotes. Product managers get the nuance they need to make confident decisions, and customers get the sense that someone is actually listening.

sections.heading: A Dashboard Built for Product Teams
sections.content:
Behind every UpVote widget is a dashboard designed for the people who actually have to act on feedback. Product managers get a clear, organized view of every request, filterable by status, votes, tags, and more.

You can move items through a visible pipeline — from "Under Review" to "Planned" to "In Progress" to "Shipped" — so your team always knows what's next, and your customers can see their feedback is moving somewhere instead of vanishing.

No more digging through spreadsheets or reconstructing context from old Slack messages. Everything about a feature request lives in one place: the original submission, the votes, the discussion, and its current status.

sections.heading: Built for Modern Teams
sections.content:
UpVote is designed to fit into the tools and workflows product teams already use. It's lightweight enough to embed in minutes, flexible enough to match your brand, and simple enough that your users won't need an onboarding tutorial just to leave feedback.

Whether you're a startup shipping fast or a growing SaaS company trying to bring structure to your roadmap, UpVote scales with you — start with the essentials, and layer on more advanced prioritization and customization as your feedback volume grows.

sections.heading: How It Works
sections.content:
Getting started with UpVote takes minutes, not weeks. Here's the typical setup:

| Step | What You Do | Outcome |
|------|-------------|---------|
| 1. Install | Drop a lightweight embed snippet into your app or website | Widget appears wherever you want feedback collected |
| 2. Customize | Match the widget to your brand's look and feel | Feels native, not bolted-on |
| 3. Collect | Users submit ideas, vote, and discuss | Feedback flows into one organized board |
| 4. Prioritize & Ship | Your team reviews votes and context, updates status | Customers see their feedback move from idea to shipped feature |

No engineering sprint required to get up and running — most teams are collecting their first feedback within the hour.

sections.heading: Join the Feedback Revolution
sections.content:
Product decisions shouldn't be a guessing game. With UpVote, you replace scattered opinions and gut instinct with a clear, prioritized signal straight from the people who matter most: your users.

Stop guessing. Start building what your customers actually want — with UpVote.

faqs.question: Is there a free plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. UpVote's Hobby Plan is free forever, so you can start collecting and prioritizing feedback without committing to a paid plan. As your needs grow, you can upgrade to unlock more advanced features and higher usage limits.

faqs.question: How do you handle spam?
faqs.answer: UpVote includes built-in moderation tools so your team can review, approve, or remove submissions before they go live, along with safeguards to help filter out spam and abuse from the feedback board.

faqs.question: Does it work on mobile apps?
faqs.answer: Yes. UpVote's widget is built to work across web and mobile apps, so you can collect contextual feedback wherever your users are.

faqs.question: Can I customize the look and feel?
faqs.answer: Yes. UpVote's widget can be customized to match your brand's colors, fonts, and styling so it feels like a native part of your product rather than a bolted-on tool.
